description: Curated parking for tourist places west and north of Toronto (agent PLACES-W). Coordinates are OSM elements (lot centre) or OSM street vertices, never estimated; 'osm' names the element. rule null = price unknown, check signs. 'price_confidence' is the curator's view of the price data (high: current official page; medium: partly inferred; low: no fee published, so its lots get a check line). free_source: osm marks a free lot whose only evidence of being free is an OSM fee=no tag; it is shown as unverified.
rule_conventions: hourly is $ per hour; per_min is the billing increment in minutes (charge = ceil(minutes / per_min) x hourly x per_min / 60); flat is per entry or per booking; season ends that move by year use named anchors (labour_day, victoria_day, fri_before_victoria_day, thanksgiving), resolved for the trip year; fixed operator dates for one year carry season_year; off season a lot is free unless the rule has off_season_rule (a full rule priced when no day of the stay is in season) or off_season "unknown" (no published price off season). Lot hours and no-overnight rules go in the lot's rule as no_parking ([{"days": [0-6], "hours": [from, to], "all_days": true}], plus "season": [MM-DD, MM-DD] for a winter ban), not only in notes: notes do not affect whether a lot fits the stay.

places.name: Barrie waterfront and downtown
rules: Waterfront lots (Centennial Beach, Johnson's Beach, Minet's Point, Centennial boat launch, Tyndale, Will Dwyer, Southshore): $15.00/h, $60.00/day without a permit, enforced 24/7 all year.
Marina and hybrid lots (Spirit Catcher, Simcoe St, North Marina) charge the same $15/h, $60/day.
Jun 15 to Sep 15, 09:00 to 21:00: streets within about 500 m of Centennial and Johnson's beaches are permit only.
Downtown: Mon to Fri 09:00 to 17:00 only; lots $1.25/h ($7/day max), Collier St parkade $1.50/h, street $1.50/h (2 h); free evenings, weekends and holidays.
Free all day: Allandale Waterfront GO station lot (Gowan St).
Dec 1 to Mar 31: no overnight parking 00:01 to 05:00 at the waterfront.

places.name: Orillia waterfront and downtown
rules: Car parking at Couchiching Beach Park, Centennial Park and Veterans' Memorial Park is free for everyone; boat trailers pay (non-residents).

Downtown: Mon to Sat 09:00 to 17:30; street $3.00/h on Mississaga St E and West St N/S, $1.75/h on side streets (2 h max); lots $1.00/h (Lots 1, 4, 6, 7, 9) or $1.25/h (Lots 2, 5, 11). Passport Parking.
Lot 10 closed Jan 19, 2026.
No street parking 00:00 to 07:00 from Nov 15 to Apr 15.
